title: Wallet restore flow beacons the recovery phrase out in a query string
intent: Models a mnemonic stealer spliced into a browser wallet's restore flow: the phrase is rejoined, base64-encoded into URLSearchParams, concatenated into a pixel URL through two intermediate variables and sent with navigator.sendBeacon. The flow rule must follow the value through each assignment and the data-preserving toString() and fire high on the beacon. Safe: host is example.invalid and no phrase value exists.
